info.caption: log2 relative quantities per biological unit, MYCN-high versus rest, normalised to ALUsq(Eurogentec), HMBS, HPRT1, SDHA(1), UBC(2); Welch's t test on the log2 scale. ODC1: 3.3× in MYCN-high versus rest (95 % confidence interval 2.3× to 4.8×; p = 3.8e-08); the conclusion holds in 99% of 744 reasonable analyses. BIRC5: 4× in MYCN-high versus rest (95 % confidence interval 2.9× to 5.5×; p = 5e-14); the conclusion holds in 100% of 744 reasonable analyses. NTRK1: 0.066× in MYCN-high versus rest (95 % confidence interval 0.032× to 0.14×; p = 1.3e-09); the conclusion holds in 84% of 744 reasonable analyses. NM23A: 2.2× in MYCN-high versus rest (95 % confidence interval 1.8× to 2.7×; p = 1.2e-09); the conclusion holds in 65% of 744 reasonable analyses.
